objective: Generalize skill/repository activation so candidates become real governed engine bindings automatically without per-skill artisanal integration.
definition_of_full: A candidate is FULL only when every relevant governed binding proves real semantic consumption, OLD_VS_NEW, QA/EVA/Tribunal, no regression, LRN feedback, observability/audit/FinOps, backup/rollback/rebuild, idempotency/restartability, zero-cost or approved exception, and physical PREPROD evidence where required.

known_live_evidence.remaining_structural_gap: ENGINEERING_TASK_REQUIRED is planned automatically but not yet fulfilled automatically into implementation plus semantic evidence; arbitrary repo URL to FULL is therefore not yet certified.

b8_acceptance: ENGINEERING_TASK_REQUIRED must become executable governed work, not a manual stop.
The worker must reuse FACT Safe Engineering, isolated worktree/sandbox policy, tests-first, rollback/rebuild and zero-cost boundaries.
No semantic evidence may be fabricated from target contracts.
A generated adapter is accepted only after real probe evidence and OLD vs NEW.
At least one previously ENGINEERING_TASK_REQUIRED candidate must advance automatically without per-skill handwritten integration.
Failures must collapse to reusable family-level reasons and remain fail-closed.
truth_guards: Never derive observed semantic evidence by echoing the target contract.
Missing evidence routes to governed engineering work instead of fabricating FULL.
Physical-required domains remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL until physical evidence exists.
Failed bindings emit HOLD learning, never GREEN learning.
GREEN scale matrix is not equivalent to 184 FULL.
communication_policy: Only milestone updates; one very short sentence stating current work, achieved result and next step.
handoff_policy: Before chat saturation or after a major block, update MASTER, STATE, RUNBOOK and HANDOFF with exact SHAs/runs/evidence and next_block. New chat must continue from evidence, not memory.
